title: Habits QoL requests
body:
Thanks for updating the Habits feature, devs! Export feature is still welcome :)
_____

Long time TickTick user. I like the app, I love how cross platform it is and the addition of the Habits feature is great. I do have some Quality of Life requests for it: - Allow a user to reset a habit count. This is useful when adding new habits and wanting to start counting old and new habits all at once. Or if you just want to refresh your habit performance. - Besides "Current streak" and "Total days", add the "Best streak" statistic in the list view. It's nice to see all the breakable records at once. - Add a “% Completed” statistic. Or a “Total Habit Days” and “Total Days Completed” statistic, instead of just the "Total Days" statistic. You want to get a good sense of how much you're sticking to a certain habit and that can be hard to tell, since each habit can have a different schedule. - Add the possibility to export your habit performance. I can imagine you won’t be adding full fledged weekly, monthly and yearly habit reports and nice habit graphs to the app. I can create these things myself though, if you’d allow me to export the data. Thanks for considering!

title: Great app but locks in, not out
body:
It works great, best app for tasks management I’ve seen so far. Of course there are some functional wishes to fulfill and I really can’t figure out why tasks, notes and habits should be separate data items or areas within the app.

The main reason I gave it a one star rating is the lack of security. Come on, it’s 2021. Cybercrime is all over the place. And this app still doesn’t offer two-factor authentication to lock the bad people out. Not even as a premium feature. Besides that, when trying to export my data there are only some text based options and copy-paste actions. Feels like locking me in.

The day this is fixed I’ll reconsider my exit.

title: Best time management app I have ever used.
body:
I really like TickTick! 

Have been using it for a week now and I must say it completely lives up to my expectations. Coming from Google Keep and Google Calendar (which are not integrated and both look ugly), this management system is a breath of fresh air. Really enjoying it! I have bought Pro subscriptions for both myself and my girlfriend so we can create lists together, anytime, anywhere. I love the fact that we can add comments to checklists so we can discuss details without changing the list.

One feature that I'm still missing (and would be nice if this is added), is the ability to create more hierarchy. Especially for business purposes, sometimes I want to create sublists for various list items. Like in Microsoft Word: when creating a list you can press "Tab" and it will indent the list item. I wish TickTick would also have a feature like that. It would make my lists even more structured.

Thanks again for making this awesome application and please keep up the good work!
